caption:
The mountain sets the pace; you decide whether to argue. When the gradient tilts and the gravel shifts, the only thing that matters is the rhythm of your own breathing. It is a quiet, singular kind of work that strips everything else away until there is nothing left but the climb and the forest watching you pass. Send this to the friend who knows what it feels like to find that kind of focus.
